text: The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews and recommend two candidates to City Council for appointment to the Exhibition Place Board.

City Council on November 9, 10 and 12, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Exhibition Place Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on November 10, 2025, and until successors are appointed: Sharleen Ahmed Howard Lichtman 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 4 to the report (October 21, 2021) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Exhibition Place Board.
